<div style="height:60px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-horizontal is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-7d812b4c wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-very-dark-gray-color has-luminous-vivid-amber-background-color has-text-color has-background wp-element-button" href="#booking" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener"><strong>Booking request</strong></a></div>
</div>
<div style="height:60px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Our Kitesurf Beach chalets are located directly on the beach and are therefore on the premises of the Beekite Village kitesurfing Station. All 11 chalets are located a maximum of 200 meters from the water.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The elegant Beekite Village Chales stand on stilts are lovingly and modernly furnished and even offer enough space for up to 3-4 people if required. 11 chalets were only built in 2023.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Of course, each Beekite Village Kitesurf Chalet has its own bathroom, king size bed and an outside shower as well as its own terrace. Air conditioning, a warm shower and a refrigerator should of course not be missing for comfort.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We are happy to serve our lavish and varied, healthy breakfast on our own terrace or in buffet form on our newly built breakfast deck.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In the evening we will also be happy to cook for you.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Praia do Macapa Kitesurf Brazil Kitesurf Spot. Offers some nice restaurants which can all be reached on foot in a few minutes. Praia do Macapa Kitesurf Spot is a small, peaceful fishing village where we have spent our winters for over 10 years. We know the helpful and friendly people of Praia do Macapa and the surrounding area well. If you are looking for the best spot and wind conditions for kitesurfing in Brazil from morning to night and you long for a safe place to relax and unwind in South America. Praia do Macapá Kitesurfing Brazil is the place for you. Smaller parties take place here every now and then, but overall it is a really relaxed and quiet fishing village. Those who want to party can go to Parnaiba, about 30 km away. There are many opportunities to party extensively on the weekend.</p>
<div style="height:60px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
